name: New York City Local Law 144 (Automated Employment Decision Tools)

use_case_categories: Automated employment decision tools (AEDTs) used in hiring and promotion
scope.description: Applies to employers and employment agencies in NYC using automated tools to screen candidates or employees for hiring or promotion.

requirements.obligation: AEDTs must undergo independent bias audit no more than one year before use
Summary of bias audit results must be made publicly available
Notify candidates that an AEDT will be used at least 10 business days before use
Allow candidates to request alternative selection process or accommodation

ai_risk_tier: Maps to GAIF High for employment decision systems

compliance_routing_rules: Route employment screening queries through bias-audited models only
behavioral_contract_thresholds: Demographic parity ratio > 0.8 across protected groups
disclosure_requirements: Public posting of bias audit results
